{{Quote|If you believe my offer merits further consideration, please contact me at the Reidi Artom Luxury Resort here in Gadrin. I am in the Chancellor's suite.|Yarian Kak, to the [[Heroes of Cularin]]|<ref name="Quarters">{{LivingForce|Blinking Eyes: Quarters}}</ref>}}
The '''Reidi Artom Luxury Resort''' was a resort that was located in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Gadrin]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]]. In circa [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], the [[Cerean/Legends|Cerean]] trade advocate [[Yarian Kak]] visited the resort, staying in the [[Chancellor's suite (Cularin)|Chancellor's suite]].
